---
title: Default Style
description: The finished components of Litefy's default style template — showcase only, no demo controls.
---

import { Avatar, Badge, Breadcrumb, Button, Callout, Chip, Checkbox, Command, DropdownMenu, Input, Kbd, Popover, Progress, Select, Skeleton, Switch, Table, Tabs, Steps, Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from "@/ui";
import { Bell, Plus, Search } from "lucide-react";

This page shows what the **default** style template ships: finished components, rendered as-is, with no demo controls around them. Every value on this page reads the semantic tokens from `theme.css`, so the whole look is one interchangeable package — see [Styles](/docs/styles) for the token layers and how templates are distributed.

## Buttons

<div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
  <Button>Primary</Button>
  <Button variant="outline">Outline</Button>
  <Button variant="danger">Danger</Button>
  <Button variant="text">Text</Button>
  <Button loadingConfig={{ loading: true }}>Saving</Button>
  <Button><Plus className="size-4" />New</Button>
  <Button aria-label="Search"><Search className="size-4" /></Button>
</div>

The look is plain classes — any element can wear it:

```tsx
<Link to="/docs" className="litefy-button litefy-button-primary">Read the docs</Link>
```

## Form controls

<div className="grid gap-3 sm:grid-cols-2">
  <Input placeholder="Search docs" leading={<Search className="size-4" />} />
  <Select placeholder="Pick a fruit" defaultValue="apple" options={[{ label: "Apple", value: "apple" }, { label: "Banana", value: "banana" }]} />
  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
    <Checkbox defaultChecked label="Keep me signed in" />
    <span className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Switch defaultChecked aria-label="Notifications" />Notifications</span>
  </div>
</div>
